newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums steady but cargoes head to region.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums steady but cargoes head to region.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums held steady on Wednesday but supplies were seen plentiful with cargoes headed to the region from Latin America and the Mediterranean.
Jet fuel barges traded at June IPE gas oil +$16.50 a tonne, steady on Tuesday's levels.
Cargoes were assessed steady at June IPE +$18, but at least two cargoes from Venezuela and one or two Med cargoes were expected to pressure premiums.
Underlying June IPE gas oil futures closed $1.25 a tonne lower on Wednesday at $176.50.
